title: Mutation from the manifests and workspace, field by field
assertion: A change confined to fields no shard reads (a non-lifecycle script in the root or any workspace manifest, a dependency or catalog entry no closure or tooling imports, the release-age and trust settings, a workspace manifest added or deleted with no install script) runs no package; a dependency or catalog entry a closure imports, or a closure manifest's module fields, run that package; the pnpm, Node and module settings, an install lifecycle script (`prepublishOnly` included) or `dependenciesMeta` in any workspace manifest, a root `node`, `deno` or `bun` entry or a specifier that is not a registry one, the test tooling, the workspace list as YAML or as the mutation tooling reads it, a reordered order-sensitive field, a YAML anchor, alias, tag or duplicate key, a `package.yaml`, `package.json5` or `.pnp.cjs`, the mutation tooling's own tsconfig, and any unlisted or unparseable field run all four
noFileReason: Manifests, workspaces and workflows are synthetic, written to a temporary directory, or this repository's own; no file.
